rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing education in pharmacotherapeutics acceptable to the Board
rules.alternatives: For the license itself, competency is shown by one of: 30 contact hours of CE, maintained national certification/recertification, an academic nursing program, or employer-verified competency and practice hours (S.C. Code §40-33-40(B)(1)). The 20 pharmacotherapeutics hours are for renewing prescriptive authority.

topics.who: NPs, CNMs and CNSs renewing prescriptive authority: pharmacotherapeutics
NPs, CNMs and CNSs with controlled substance prescriptive authority: 2 of the 20 hours related to prescribing controlled substances
All LPNs, RNs and APRNs: before Jan 1, 2028 if licensed before 2026 (within 2 years of initial licensure otherwise), then every 6 years; Board-approved provider

rules.notes: Licenses renew biennially. Prescriptive authority renewal needs documentation of 20 pharmacotherapeutics contact hours every 2 years.
rules.rule_quote: (3) Authorization for prescriptive authority must be renewed after the applicant meets requirements for renewal and provides documentation of twenty hours acceptable to the board of continuing education contact hours every two years in pharmacotherapeutics.
